decisions.D-TR-1: Whitespace-only segments are structural separators; not sent to the model; reinserted exactly and in order.
decisions.D-TR-2: Segments with zero Urdu-script letters (Arabic-script Unicode letters) bypass translation and are preserved exactly; any segment containing an Urdu-script letter is translated. Arabic-block punctuation/digits are not letters.
decisions.D-TR-3: Reversible reassembly: all separators, whitespace, line breaks and ordering preserved; only the stripped core of translatable segments is replaced; units are additionally cut at line breaks so no line break lies inside a translated span.
decisions.D-TR-4: Translation source = parsed.reasoning_span, identical to the span scored by the direct judge (verified mechanically 2026-10-05: 936/936 EN and 935/935 UR direct-judge prompts contain exactly parsed.reasoning_span; 0 contain generated_completion).
decisions.D-TR-5: After line/sentence/clause/whitespace-token segmentation, any piece still over 200 source tokens undergoes one deterministic greedy character-preserving re-split into maximal prefixes within the limit; otherwise fail closed. Output reaching max_length without EOS fails closed (no output-side re-split).
decisions.D-TR-6: Tasks with failed attempts 1-2 may receive attempt 3 only under explicit investigator resume authorization; historical attempts immutable; preflight validates contiguous numbered attempt history.

historical_records: attempts 1-2 for 3 tasks were produced under the base contract with the batched implementation; they remain immutable failure records.
